    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Application
    Represents a student's application to an internship.
    ApplicationManager
    Manages application operations including creation, status updates, and business rules.
    ApplicationStatus
    Status of a student's internship application.
    ApprovalStatus
    Approval status for company representatives and withdrawal requests.
    AuthenticationController
    Handles user authentication, login, logout, and password changes.
    CareerCenterStaff
    Represents a career center staff member.
    CareerCenterStaffMenu
    Menu for career center staff operations including approvals, reviews, and report generation.
    CompanyRepresentative
    Represents a company representative user.
    CompanyRepresentativeMenu
    Menu for company representative operations including creating internships and reviewing applications.
    DateUtils
    Utility class for date parsing and formatting.
    FileManager
    Utility class for file operations including serialization and CSV reading.
    FilterManager
    Manages user filter settings persistence and retrieval.
    FilterSettings
    Stores user-specific filter and sorting preferences for internship listings.
    FilterSettings.SortCriteria
    Available sorting criteria for internship listings.
    IdGenerator
    Generates unique IDs for internships, applications, and withdrawal requests.
    InputValidator
    Utility class for validating user input.
    Internship
    Represents an internship opportunity posted by a company representative.
    InternshipLevel
    Difficulty level of an internship opportunity.
    InternshipManager
    Manages internship operations including CRUD, filtering, and eligibility checks.
    InternshipPlacementSystem
    Main entry point for the Internship Placement Management System.
    InternshipStatus
    Status of an internship opportunity.
    LoginMenu
    Menu for user login and company representative registration.
    MenuInterface
    Abstract base class for all menu interfaces.
    PasswordChangeResult
    Result of a password change attempt.
    Student
    Represents a student user in the system.
    StudentMenu
    Menu for student operations including viewing internships, applying, and managing applications.
    User
    Abstract base class representing a user in the system.
    UserManager
    Manages user operations including authentication, CRUD, and CSV loading.
    UserRole
    User roles in the system.
    WithdrawalManager
    Manages withdrawal request operations including creation and staff review.
    WithdrawalRequest
    Represents a student's request to withdraw from an application or placement.
